data.title: Explicit feedback citing skill-depth shortfall
data.content:
# Explicit feedback citing skill-depth shortfall

Interviewer or recruiter provides structured notes citing a specific deficit in algorithmic complexity, architecture, or tool mastery.

### Diagnostic Non-Inferences
- Does not imply general incompetence; it reflects the threshold for this specific role level.
data.summary: Interviewer or recruiter provides structured notes citing a specific deficit in algorithmic complexity, architecture, or tool mastery.

probes.action: Review the interview solution against the standard patterns for that problem and identify the edge cases it misses.
probes.expected_signal: Verifies whether the code actually lacked the optimisation or rigour the notes name.

outcomes.label: The solution has the property the feedback names, and the approach it expected is a standard pattern for that problem.
The solution has the property the feedback names, and the approach it expected is specific to one stack or house pattern rather than a general one.
The solution does not have the property the feedback names — the code already does what the notes say was missing.
Nothing was retained from the exercise — a shared editor closed, a whiteboard erased — so the claim cannot be checked against anything.

specimens.label: Structured feedback notes
specimens.subject: Feedback — technical panel

lines.text: The panel was positive on system decomposition and on how you reasoned about failure modes.

The gap was in the second exercise: the solution was correct but quadratic, and the panel was looking for the linear approach using a hash index. We would want to see that reached without prompting at this level.
We are not moving forward now, but this was close and we would welcome a re-application in six months.

specimens.reading: A named exercise, a named property, a named expectation. This is the rare rejection that is actually actionable.

specimens.label: The moment in the panel

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: This works. What is the complexity?

lines.speaker: Candidate
lines.text: Quadratic — nested scan over the same list.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Right. Can you get it down?

lines.speaker: Candidate
lines.text: Probably with an index of some kind. I would want to think about it.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: That is fine, let us move on for time.

specimens.reading: The transcript and the written feedback agree. When they agree, the feedback is describing something that actually happened.

perspectives.sees: A rejection that names the exercise, the property of the solution and the expectation for the level, together with a stated window for re-application.
perspectives.reads: A threshold for this level in one named place, which is a claim that can be checked against what happened in the room.
perspectives.does: Checks the claim against their own record of the panel, and works from the two facts given: the named gap and the named window.

perspectives.sees: The panel's write-ups against the rubric, including the exercise where the step to the linear solution came after a prompt.
perspectives.reads: Evidence about the bar for the level rather than about the person; a decline can be revisited in six months and a hire cannot.
perspectives.does: Declines for now, keeps the exercise and the property in the notes, and leaves the re-application open.

perspectives.sees: A recommendation with a written reason attached to it, and none of the scoring that stands behind the reason.
perspectives.reads: A reason specific enough to send as written; the field it arrived in is free text, so what is in it is what the panel typed there.
perspectives.does: Sends the reason in the panel's own terms and adds the re-application window, and cannot expand on it if asked, because the scoring did not travel with it.

non_inferences: Does not imply general incompetence; it reflects the threshold for this specific role level.
